Definition: Tabbath, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Tabbath was a place east of the Jordan, near which Gideon's pursuit of the fleeing Midianites stopped. The name means celebrated, and the site is otherwise unknown. It is named once, as the far edge of a night pursuit that began with three hundred men and trumpets.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the far edge of the pursuit matters: Gideon followed the victory until the enemy was gone, and the place where he stopped got a name in the book.
